name: github
purpose: Repositories, issues and pull requests on github.com

apiKey.help: github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained personal access tokens; give it the repositories and permissions your agents need

guide:
The GitHub REST API (https://docs.github.com/rest) and GraphQL API, as the person.

```sh
curl -s https://api.github.com/user
curl -s 'https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/issues?state=open&per_page=20'
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/pulls/42/files
curl -s -X POST https://api.github.com/graphql -d '{"query":"query { viewer { login } }"}'
```

Changes (creating an issue, commenting, merging) ask the person first unless they allowed changes:

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/issues -d '{"title":"…","body":"…"}'
```

`gh` works where it trusts the proxy's CA (in the sandbox); on a macOS host use curl.
